chunks: And the many spoils that they were to take. God is all-mighty and all-wise.
ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about the spoils of war and God's attributes in this verse?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah Al-Anfal is often linked to the Battle of Badr, illustrating how divine wisdom (Hikmah) orchestrated the distribution of spoils to strengthen the nascent Muslim community's economic and spiritual resolve. The attributes of 'Aziz' (All-Powerful) and 'Hakim' (All-Wise) underscore that these material gains were not merely military outcomes but calculated acts of divine providence to validate the believers' faith.
